Attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
Idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
‘Idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasacca’nti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi.
Na ca labbhati rūpe: ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
Manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā.
Attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā.
Rūpañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya.
Dveme, bhikkhave, antā pabbajitena na sevitabbā.
Ekāyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo, yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā.
Kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā.
Nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya.
Ekaṃ atthapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
Gāravo ca nivāto ca, santuṭṭhi ca kataññutā; Kālena dhammassavanaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalamuttamaṃ.
Yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ.
Gāravo ca nivāto ca, santuṭṭhi ca kataññutā.
Yathā yathā vā panassa kāyo paṇihito hoti, tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti.
Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati.
Evaṃ me sutaṃ — ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
Idaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
